source_deviation: S2ORC bulk access was not configured. Official S2ORC directs acquisition through Semantic Scholar. The allenai/s2orc Hugging Face lookup returned not found. Do not substitute an undocumented mirror.
eligibility: Versioned arXiv HTML with one abstract and unambiguous top-level introduction, related work, and conclusion sections
Complete bibliography and no obvious extraction debris
At least 60 words per target section and at least 10 bibliography entries
Whole visible contexts and four-failure feedback fit every pinned endpoint without truncation
No duplicate titles, manuscript versions, or author overlap with previously selected papers
No paper whose subject directly studies rubric optimization or this XAR procedure
selection: First 20 eligible papers in frozen discovery order; first 2 are pilots; shuffle next 13 with seed 20260929 for 8 train and 5 validation; last 5 are confirmation
replacement_order: Frozen discovery order, with every exclusion recorded before generation
normalization: Whitespace normalization and equivalent HTML math/heading handling only; no expert rewriting
redistribution: Raw papers and extracted text stay local unless an individually verified license allows release; publish URLs, hashes, and reconstruction commands
inspection: Record agent extraction/suitability inspection separately from human review; human suitability review remains an explicit acceptance gate
limitations: Recent preprints may lack peer review. Report publication status for every selected paper and do not claim guaranteed expert writing.
context_screen: Pinned official Qwen/Kimi tokenizers; maximum count with 25% headroom, four complete failure contexts and candidate pairs, 16000 feedback overhead tokens, and 16384 output tokens. Every actual request is checked again.
amendment_before_grading: Initial UTF-8-byte-as-token screen was needlessly restrictive; all rejection logs from that pass are preserved separately. No candidate generation or grading occurred before this amendment.
